channel.name: BBC One NL
channel.title: Dr Xand's Con or Cure
channel.desc: Dr Xand hears the shocking story of 17,500 Northern Ireland-based women whose cervical smear results were suspected to be wrong. Plus, as the sale of gut health drinks soars, the team investigate their efficacy. Also, the heartbreaking story of young people locked up in hospitals in Scotland, with little access to their families.
